hook: Getty Images was worth *$4.8B*. Now it's bankrupt.
dek: The stock photo giant is filing Chapter 11 and going private.

slides.label: What happened
slides.text: Getty Images announced it's filing for *Chapter 11 bankruptcy* and plans to go private.

slides.label: The numbers
slides.text: The company was valued at *$4.8 billion* in 2021. Now Koch is investing up to $533 million to restructure it.

slides.label: Who's in control
slides.text: Ownership shifts fully to the *Getty family* and Koch Equity Development, the investment arm of Koch, Inc.

slides.label: Why now
slides.text: Getty has faced *declining demand* as AI generated imagery disrupts its stock photo and iStock ecommerce business.

slides.label: Plan B collapsed
slides.text: A planned merger with *Shutterstock*, announced in January, was scrapped before this deal came together.

slides.label: Business as usual
slides.text: Despite the bankruptcy filing, the company says *vendors will be paid in full* and operations continue normally.

slides.label: Leadership speaks
slides.text: Chairman *Mark Getty* called it a chance to build on a solid foundation and seize new growth opportunities.

slides.label: Why it matters
slides.text: Stock photography has long been a paycheck for *underrepresented photographers and creators*, and this shows how fast AI can upend that income.

question: Will Getty survive going private? Yes or no.

Getty Images was worth $4.8 billion just four years ago. Now the stock photo giant is filing for Chapter 11 bankruptcy and going private, according to Fast Company.

The restructuring hands full control to the Getty family and Koch Equity Development, the investment arm of Koch, Inc., which is putting in up to $533 million. A planned merger with Shutterstock, announced back in January, fell apart before this deal came together. Company leaders point to declining demand and disruption from AI generated imagery as the business struggles to find its footing. Vendors will still get paid in full while the process plays out.

For the photographers and creators who built careers licensing images through platforms like Getty, this is a reminder that AI is reshaping entire income streams fast, and nobody is fully insulated.

Will Getty survive going private? Yes or no.
